log_data_indefinite: log Spot robot camera data and state indefinitely until Ctrl+C is pressed
log_data_finite: log Spot robot camera data and state for a specified number of steps
replay_log_data: replay previously logged Spot robot camera data from a pickle file
setup_logging_sources: setup and verify camera sources for logging Spot robot data
dump_pkl: dump logged robot data packets to a timestamped pickle file
